data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's claim is conditional on the checklist being crowd-evolved, but the problem asks to argue for or against the panel versus a single expert and to identify evidence distinguishing genuine gain from compliance. SRC_002 restricts the positive claim to crowd-evolved checklists, making it an incomplete answer to the problem. Moreover, its criterion for distinguishing genuine gain (probing items where checklist and author disagree with broader expert population) fails when the broader expert population shares the same biases, which is common in domains with systematic blind spots.
